title: Small Mirror state plus private synapse exceptions on event domains
scope: CPU adaptation-boundary screen using real event Vernier trials from two sensor-distance domains. The model is a small recurrent SNN adapter, not a reproduction of the paper's pretrained Transformer.
hypothesis: A shared recurrent SNN trained on D1 can retain D1 performance and adapt to D2 using a compact threshold coordinate plus a sparse private synapse mask, reaching independent-D2 quality with a smaller actual joint payload than a full private SNN.

data.dataset: Event-Based Tiny Images D1 and D2 Vernier trials, Zenodo 20973757
data.inputs: first 48 chronological events at or after 80 ms; fields timestamp,x,y,polarity; official timestamp rescale to ms
data.targets: sign(label-20) for event trials labelled 13..19 or 21..27
data.split: One frozen whole-trial stratified 60/20/20 partition: D1 split seed 96900 and D2 split seed 96901. Development run uses only train/development partitions. Fresh optimizer seeds 96911/13/17 share the locked fresh test trials; they are not independent acquisitions.

model.architecture: 8-neuron recurrent LIF with shared 8x4 input synapses, subtractive reset, threshold vector and spike-count linear readout
model.training: surrogate sigmoid threshold gradient; D1 core trained first; D2 adaptation freezes D1 core and optimizes listed state only; early stopping on D2 development

controls: D1 shared core zero-shot on D2
shared core plus direct per-domain threshold vector (native STL-style control)
shared core plus one-dimensional Mirror threshold coordinate
Mirror threshold coordinate plus top-k private synapse entries, k in [1,2,4,8,16,32]
independent D2 recurrent SNN while retaining the D1 model

storage.authority: actual torch.save joint D1+D2 inference payload bytes

success_gate: At some k, Mirror+private reaches within 2 points of independent D2 accuracy and within 1 point of D1 retention while joint payload is <=80% independent and better than the direct threshold-only control at the same byte/MAC budget.
failure_gate: No k meets quality and byte gates; Mirror equals native threshold control; or private residual cost exceeds the independent joint payload.
post_run_audit: Invalid screen: sparse scatter overwrites shared weights rather than adding delta; implemented surrogate and MAC proxy mismatch frozen protocol; serialized replay incomplete; D1 and independent D2 near chance. No mechanism-level conclusion; any correction is a new amendment/ID.
boundaries: This is one real acquisition with two distance domains; three split/model seeds are not independent sensor acquisitions.
The D1/D2 labels provide sign classification, not the paper's MNIST-pretrained hyperacuity transfer result.
No TACOS reproduction, hardware energy, or deployment latency claim.
Sparse residual index/values and all D1+D2 reconstruction state are charged.
